take.name: board admitted by an admin, base rights
take.note: an ordinary leaf: any admin with admit admits it, and it obeys the group's admins

take.name: device with an optional field from a later version
take.note: key 300 is in the optional zone: ignored, covered by the signature

take.name: device with a critical field from a later version
take.note: key 99 is unknown in the critical zone: keep, pass on, do not apply

take.name: record of a type from a later version
take.note: unknown type: keep, pass on, do not apply

take.name: second signer named (room only in 0.6)
take.note: signer2 (key 8) with a three-element envelope; 0.6 checks the first signature, keeps the record and never applies it

take.name: admin admits a desktop with secrets (its own device has them)
take.note: the admin's own device (the root's phone record, admin key) has the secrets bit, so it may give it; one without it may not (records/device/admin-rights)

take.name: guarded lock admitted by the root
take.note: guarded (25): only the root admits it and signs its grant

take.name: admin marks a leaf guarded
take.note: records/device/guarded: only a root sets guarded; the form is valid, the evaluation counts it for nothing

take.name: admin widens a device it admitted
take.note: records/device/admin-rights: an admin never widens rights (here: hub); the form is valid, the evaluation counts it for nothing
